description_expanded: Top Reasons to book this Lovely Home:* 350 yards to Gulf Point Road Beach Access!* Patio seating with propane grill* 4 Bikes Included* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village* Just 2 miles from Gulf Place Town Center to the West and 2 miles from Grayton Beach to the East* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed, 24/7 service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.**Home is equipped with outdoor surveillance cameras for your safety and protection of our property. Any attempt to disable, redirect, or obscure the cameras is prohibited and will result in eviction without a refund**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Nestled in the Old Blue Mountain Beach community, Dunestruck is a charming, newly renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home that is perfect for your next 30A beach getaway! Climb the stairs to enter this beautiful home to find vaulted ceilings, fresh paint, new stainless-steel appliances, and beautifully updated décor throughout. This home contains 2 queen bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, and a sleeper sofa in the living room, sleeping 6 comfortably. Step outside onto the patio where you can barbecue with the propane grill or just sit and enjoy a cup of coffee among the natural surroundings. Underneath the home, there is an additional location for outdoor relaxation with a gas firepit to enjoy during the evenings. The house sits conveniently off Scenic Highway 30A, just a short walk to the pristine white sands of Blue Mountain Beach or to several delicious local dining spots. Staying in this part of Blue Mountain Beach provides exclusive deeded access to three private beach entrances, as well as the right to use all portions of the beach front property in those areas. Parking along the roads that border the private beach accesses is prohibited. Dunestruck with enthrall you with its charm and beauty and give you a 30A vacation that will make you want to return here year after year.The Old Blue Mountain Beach Community is located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach. Tucked in between the tranquil Big Redfish Lake and the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico the Old Blue Mountain Beach community is conveniently located. You’ll be within a couple of blocks of Redfish Village with shops and restaurants, bike and surf rentals and other conveniences. Don’t forget to walk over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a homemade scoop! Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Explore Redfish Lake, one of the few coastal dune lakes in the world. Come and see for yourself what makes Blue Mountain Beach and the 30A area so special! The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedLiving Room: Queen Sleeper SofaArea Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 2 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
